## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game based on retro 1989 Roblox-style interactive block-world physics, with models and drivable cars.

## Requirements
- Include interactive physics, block-style models, roads, houses, trees, traffic, and cars.
- Support desktop and mobile controls.
- Use a retro 1989 visual style.
- (none beyond the above)

## Decisions
- Implemented as a self-contained Three.js browser game in `index.html`.
- Used an external Three.js CDN module rather than a local package.
- Modeled the world procedurally with geometric primitives.
- Added a follow camera, keyboard/touch controls, collision boundaries, enter/exit vehicle behavior, and a cash counter.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the full single-file game in `index.html`.
- Added roads, sidewalks, houses, trees, lampposts, player actor, and multiple vehicles.
- Added keyboard and mobile controls.
- Added drivable vehicle movement, steering, world boundaries, and house collisions.
- Added enter/exit interaction for the main car.
- Added desktop and mobile responsive HUD.
- Launched a local server and visually verified the page in Chromium with screenshots.
- Corrected one malformed traffic setup and removed an invalid animation call.

### Active
- Final browser verification is complete; no unresolved implementation work is explicitly identified.

### Blocked
- Vehicle forward movement test showed the cash counter remains `B$ 0`; verify whether the test starts the car facing or moving in the intended direction.

## Next Move
1. Test pressing `E` near the red car and hold `W` to confirm acceleration and cash accumulation.
2. Test steering and collision behavior around houses and world boundaries.
3. Test touch controls at mobile viewport sizes.
4. Replace or localize the CDN Three.js dependency if fully offline operation is required.
5. Inspect the final screenshot and refine any visual issues.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/linux.jpg`: Latest browser verification screenshot.

## Important Context
- The game is available at `http://localhost:3002` while the Python HTTP server remains running.
- The screenshot was captured at 1280×720 using Chromium SwiftShader software rendering.
- The browser verification found no JavaScript page errors.
- The only browser console error observed was a generic 404 resource request.
- Desktop controls are `W/A/S/D` or arrow keys, and `E` or `Space` enters/exits the car.
- Mobile controls include directional buttons and an enter/exit button.
